Done! I've successfully added a `סך הכל` (sum total) particle to the payments screen.

## Summary

**What I did:**
- Added a new particle line to `machtzev/generator/specs-ds/sechirut.txt` that sums all payment amounts
- Regenerated the app using the standard app-ds generator
- Verified the particle was correctly wired into the UI

**How I know it works:**
- The particle appears in the generated plan as a sum-type aggregation for the `תשלום` entity
- All functional tests pass (autoskin, autologic, skingolden, pre-tool, atom-count)
- The particle follows the same pattern as the existing `הכנסה` (income) particle and renders as a KpiTile with ProgressRing
- No existing functionality was broken

The new `סך הכל` particle will display the total of all payment amounts on the payments screen using the same visual component as other summary metrics.
